Cleaning clips are adapted from these Freesound recordings, all CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

wax-sizzle.wav: Water_Sizzle_TwoDrops.wav by tcrocker68
https://freesound.org/people/tcrocker68/sounds/235597/

water-bubbles.wav and water-dip.wav: Bubbles Light Short Descend.wav by murraysortz
https://freesound.org/people/murraysortz/sounds/192496/

water-dip.wav surface splash: Water drop (splash) by bolkmar
https://freesound.org/people/bolkmar/sounds/451126/

water-dip.wav and water-lift.wav: Water plopping in pulling out small object.wav by vjoe1985
https://freesound.org/people/vjoe1985/sounds/233975/

The clips are trimmed, downmixed, gain-adjusted and layered.
